tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd
u = pd.read_csv('utilization.csv')
c = pd.read_csv('instance_catalog.csv')
row = u[u.instance_id=='i-302808d1d3f1'].iloc[0]
cur = c[c.instance_type==row.instance_type].iloc[0]
req_v = cur.vcpu * row.p95_cpu_pct/100 / 0.7
req_m = cur.memory_gib * row.p95_mem_pct/100 / 0.8
print(cur)
print(req_v, req_m)
fam = c[(c.family==cur.family) & (c.vcpu>=req_v) & (c.memory_gib>=req_m)]
print(fam.sort_values('hourly_usd'))
